usage.reason: The provided documentation excerpt shows no per-user last-active field, activity log or per-user usage report. The division user records only contain id, email and display name.

evidence.quote: List the users of a division under your account.
Use the next page token to paginate through a large set of results.

assumptions: The documentation excerpt does not include Zoom's account-wide user listing (the main Users endpoint). I used the division users listing instead, which is the closest account-level list shown.
The context step takes the first division returned by /divisions and assumes it is the main division holding all users. This is not confirmed; if users sit in other divisions they will be missed.
Division users carry no status, role, user type, last-active or created fields, so those are left empty. Suspended or deactivated users may not be shown.

The excerpt cuts off before the authentication section. I assumed a Bearer access token in the Authorization header (Zoom OAuth, ideally a server-to-server app that survives staff leaving). The token URL was not in the source, so no OAuth flow is configured.
Divisions are marked as not supported in the Gov cluster, so this connector will not work on Gov accounts.
Division endpoints need the division:read:admin scope. No paid plan requirement is stated for them.
The maximum page size for divisions was not documented; I used the default of 30.
Rate limits are given only as labels such as LIGHT, with no numbers, so rate limit values are left empty.
No usage signal was found, so usage is marked unavailable.
